inputs.prompt: <Video 1> <Picture 1> <Picture 2> <Picture 3> <Picture 4> In a quiet Chinese hospital ward with pale green lower walls and cool white upper walls, three tall windows with a radiator beneath them and pale gauzy curtains, a metal hospital bed with white bedding and a blue blanket, a wooden bedside cabinet with a thermos flask and a white mug, an IV stand, a tall wooden wardrobe and a round wall clock, all arranged as in the reference <Picture 4>. Three people only. An elderly Chinese woman with the same face exactly matching the reference portrait <Picture 1>, short silver-white hair, wearing a pale blue hospital gown, lying propped up on pillows in the hospital bed. An adult Chinese woman with the same face exactly matching the reference portrait <Picture 2>, shoulder-length dark hair, wearing a plain cream knit cardigan, standing beside the bed. A little Chinese girl with the same face exactly matching the reference portrait <Picture 3>, two dark braids, wearing a white shirt with red suspenders, beside the bed. At the very start of the shot a lidded thermal food container sits on the bedside cabinet, large and clearly readable, with its lid on. In the first second of the shot, in one continuous slow gentle sequence, the adult daughter lowers her gaze and lifts the lid off the thermal food container with one hand, carries the lid sideways and sets it down beside the container, and thin wisps of hot steam rise continuously from the open container and grow slightly stronger, carrying the warmth of chicken soup. The lid stays visible on the cabinet for the whole shot, never vanishing and never changing into another object; the container and the lid only do this one continuous movement. Then the little girl leans over the bedside and gently takes her grandmother's hand with both hands, her braids falling forward so the ends of her hair brush the back of the old woman's hand; she looks up and says one quiet line as if asking her grandmother to come and see her dance. The elderly woman looks at the child, her lips move as if about to answer, then she stops and stays quiet, with a small tender and sad expression. The pale white ward light stays soft and even, with the child's hair and the steam as the only gentle motion; any passage of time or memory is suggested only by this continuous quiet light and by the stillness of the three faces, never shown as another place or another time. Throughout the shot there is no flashback, no memory image, no old ward, no younger version of any character, no superimposed image, no hard cut, no cross-space transition and no other time or place shown at any point. The hospital bed, the bedside cabinet, the thermos flask, the white mug, the IV stand, the three windows, the radiator, the curtains, the wooden wardrobe, the wall clock, the thermal food container and its lid stay where they are and never disappear or move abruptly. All three faces are clear and detailed and remain stable, exactly matching <Picture 1>, <Picture 2> and <Picture 3>; none of them changes, ages, or swaps with another. All movements are gradual and continuous with no sudden movement, no abrupt pose changes, no teleporting and no hard cuts, and no fourth person appears. Soft even white hospital light, cool green-white walls and warm cream wood tones, no harsh spotlight, no lens flare, no hard-edged light patch.
